description: The wiki pages you starred, in the order you starred them, across every space — or one space's with 'spaceKey'. Only the pages you may read now: a page you lost access to, or one in the trash, is not listed (its star is kept and comes back with the access). Each with its id, title, space and when it was starred; 'archived' for a page in its space's archive.

spaceKey.description: Only this space's starred pages (the space key is the project's key).

name: list_starred_wiki_pages
title: List starred wiki pages
